podcast.body: Initially, this debut album sold poorly after its release. However, sales dramatically increased, becoming a "smash," following the release of the "Bee Girl" video. The album has since sold almost 5 million copies, with royalties continuing to pour in. "Eventually, Blind Mellon was able to record a debut album, but even then it sold poorly. That is until The Bee Girl."
